claim: Latest whole Qwen learner preserves expensive Transformer core and BF16/F32 SwiGLU. Prepared C profile is an unexecuted diagnostic, not original-engine deployment admission.
At fixed L,D,h,k selected expert arithmetic/code traffic can be independent of E; original router and total allocations are E-dependent. Overall parameter-independent speed/quality remains unproved.
Pretrained cross-architecture, conditional and ternary adaptation each has reported evidence. No source in this review proves their composition in the project engine or its T4 budget.
Next perform target-compatible metadata/cost triage of recurrent/hybrid, ternary, and local Transformer donors before choosing one staged offline conversion pilot.
Human accepts month-plus T4 adaptation as a possible route. Actual allocation, FP16-compatible implementation, throughput and stop criteria must be established before T4 execution.
